G L E U H R
Wellness Pvt Ltd
FRONT DESK MANAGER
Training Framework  ·  10–14 days at Chandigarh HQ
Structured across three streams — Operations Audit, Client Experience, Reporting & Leadership
How This Training Works
Every Front Desk Manager goes through this programme at Chandigarh before being deployed to a clinic. The programme runs 10 to 14 days, depending on the trainee's learning curve. Sign-off comes from every trainer plus a final readiness test — three consecutive days running a Chandigarh branch's operations and audit cycle solo.
Three streams
STREAM 1 — Operations Audit. Reception, housekeeping, therapist cabins, hygiene and compliance. Owned by Jaspreet (Chandigarh BM), Arshpreet and Saurabh.
STREAM 2 — Client Experience. Greeting standards, wait-time and flow, complaint handling and service recovery, NPS. Owned by Jaspreet and Saurabh.
STREAM 3 — Reporting & Leadership. Operations metrics and reporting, daily floor discipline, coaching reception and housekeeping, escalation discipline. Owned by Saurabh and the Regional Head.
Sign-off principle
Sign-off requires evidence of competence, plus a final readiness test.  The final test: three consecutive days at Chandigarh where the trainee runs the operations cycle solo — Jaspreet steps back and observes from a distance while the trainee runs the reception huddle, housekeeping huddle, cabin audits, complaint handling and end-of-day reporting independently. Only when all three days run cleanly is she signed off.
STREAM 1  ·  OPERATIONS AUDIT
Module 1  ·  Reception Operations Audit
Trainer:  Jaspreet (BM Chandigarh)
What the trainee must be able to do by end of module
Audit the reception team against the 10-item scorecard
Run the reception morning huddle (5 min)
Coach a receptionist on a specific gap in 10 minutes
Identify CRM hygiene issues — missing entries, mistagged leads, missed callbacks
Activities
Day 1: Shadow Jaspreet's reception huddle and scorecard
Day 2: Co-run the huddle, then run it solo with Jaspreet observing
Day 2: Independent reception scorecard exercise vs Jaspreet's score
Sign-off criteria
Can run the reception huddle independently
Scorecard accuracy within 1 point of Jaspreet's
Has coached at least one receptionist live
Jaspreet confirms readiness
Module 2  ·  Housekeeping & Hygiene Audit
Trainer:  Arshpreet + Saurabh
What the trainee must be able to do by end of module
Audit housekeeping end-to-end against the 6-item wall-poster standard
Run the housekeeping morning huddle in Hindi, in the right register
Coach the housekeeping team without triggering fear or withdrawal
Understand Saurabh's compliance framework and how it ties to branch audits
Activities
Day 1: Walk Arshpreet's full hygiene audit
Day 2: Independent hygiene audit vs Arshpreet's findings
Day 2: 60 min with Saurabh on the compliance framework
Sign-off criteria
Independent hygiene audit findings match Arshpreet within 1 point
Can communicate with the housekeeping team in their language and register
Arshpreet + Saurabh confirm readiness
Module 3  ·  Therapist Cabin Audit — Operational
Trainer:  Senior Therapist + Arshpreet
Audit operations, not clinical.  The FDM audits the operational standard of the cabin — prep, hygiene, timer, handoff, cabin log. Clinical judgement stays with the doctor. Learn the boundary precisely; an FDM who strays into clinical correction damages the peer structure.
What the trainee must be able to do by end of module
Audit cabin operational standard — prep, hygiene, timer, handoff, cabin log
Identify therapists rushing sessions or skipping operational steps
Know the three operational rules — timer, verbal handoff, cabin log
Know clearly what is operational (FDM) vs clinical (doctor)
Activities
Day 1: Cabin audit walk with Arshpreet
Day 2: Independent cabin audit vs Arshpreet's findings
Day 2: Boundary exercise — 10 'operational vs clinical' scenarios with the Senior Doctor
Sign-off criteria
Can audit cabin operational standard independently
Boundary exercise scored correctly
Senior Therapist + Arshpreet confirm readiness
STREAM 2  ·  CLIENT EXPERIENCE
Module 4  ·  Client Experience & Complaint Handling
Trainer:  Jaspreet + Saurabh
What the trainee must be able to do by end of module
Hold the greeting and wait-time standards on the floor
Run service recovery using the L.E.A.R.N. method
Close a DSAT case the same day it is raised
Read and interpret NPS / CSAT and complaint trends
Activities
Day 1: Observe live front-desk experience at Chandigarh; note recovery moments
Day 2: Role-play complaint scenarios with Jaspreet
Day 2: NPS / complaint-trend reading exercise with Saurabh
Sign-off criteria
Can run a service-recovery conversation confidently
Closes a practice DSAT correctly within SLA
Saurabh confirms readiness
STREAM 3  ·  REPORTING & LEADERSHIP
Module 5  ·  Operations Metrics & Reporting
Trainer:  Saurabh
What the trainee must be able to do by end of module
Compile and file the morning readiness report
Compile and file the end-of-day operations report
Build the weekly operations report to Saurabh
Read the operations scorecard and keep operational data accurate
Activities
Day 1: Session with Saurabh on the operations metric set
Day 2: Draft a full day's morning + EOD report from Chandigarh data
Day 3: Build a weekly operations report and defend the numbers
Sign-off criteria
Reports are accurate, complete and on time
Can read the operations scorecard confidently
Saurabh confirms readiness in writing
Module 6  ·  Floor Discipline & Daily Rhythm
Trainer:  Jaspreet
What the trainee must be able to do by end of module
Run the daily floor — huddles, hourly rounds, asks register
Verify CCTV and secure cash with reception at closing
Feed operational truth into the daily BM-Doctor meeting
Hold the floor visibly without micromanaging the team
Activities
Day 1: Shadow Jaspreet's full floor day
Day 2: Run the floor rhythm with Jaspreet observing
Day 2: Prepare the operational inputs for a BM-Doctor meeting
Sign-off criteria
Can run the daily floor rhythm independently
Closing (CCTV + cash) completed correctly
Jaspreet confirms readiness
Module 7  ·  Escalation & The Operations Line
Trainer:  Saurabh + Regional Head
What the trainee must be able to do by end of module
Know the escalation matrix — L1 floor, L2 to Saurabh, L3 immediate
Know what the FDM decides vs what is escalated
Hold the clinical / operational boundary
Understand hard-line discipline and what comes to the founder
Activities
Day 1: Escalation matrix walkthrough with Saurabh
Day 2: 10 escalation scenarios — decide level and route
Day 2: Session with the Regional Head on the operations line and hard-line discipline
Sign-off criteria
Escalation scenarios routed correctly
Clear understanding of the operations line and hard-line rules
Saurabh + RH confirm readiness
